verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Sentry serves a functioning llms.txt at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with structured content describing the platform, and Sentry also documents agent-oriented onboarding (one command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Grok to install Sentry) plus an official MCP server for agent access to docs/errors. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent consuming llms.txt produces correct results, and no dedicated agent-facing doc beyond the single llms.txt file.
